title: NavigationConfig
description: The primary and secondary navigation. The primary nav is fixed at five items per OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §6.1 and §7.1: Start, Architecture, Evidence, Status, GitHub. The secondary nav holds orbit items that are reached from inside the primary pages. The footer holds the canonical origin, license, authorship, and repository link.

primary.description: The primary navigation, rendered in the site header. Exactly five items: Start, Architecture, Evidence, Status, GitHub.

external.description: True for items that leave the site (e.g., GitHub).

secondary.description: Orbit items, reachable from inside the primary pages. The conditional routes (Prism ML, General Compute) are in this list when they exist.

from.description: The primary page from which this item is reached.

conditional.description: True for items that may not exist (Prism ML, General Compute).
